title: Vibe Deck plugin manifest
description: plugin.json at the root of a plugin folder (official-plugins/<id>/ or plugins/<id>/).

name.description: Name shown in the control panel and in the market.

type.description: "pack" = a bundle that only lists other plugins in "includes".

includes.description: Plugins installed together with this pack.

platforms.description: Systems the plugin works on (default: both).

permissions.description: What the plugin uses: shown before installing.

exec.description: true if the plugin starts programs (child_process). Required when its code does.

network.description: true if the plugin code uses the network (fetch, http, sockets). Required when its code does, unless permissions.http lists the hosts.

commands.description: Allowed commands it defines or uses.
